## Summary

Describe the change and the finding, bug, or documentation issue it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] JavaScript syntax checks pass.
- [ ] PowerShell syntax checks pass.
- [ ] `node glint-claimer.mocktest.js` passes when relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and examples use synthetic or redacted data.

## Privacy and authorization

- [ ] No cookies, credentials, webhooks, local paths, or personal identifiers are included.
- [ ] Any network testing was performed against a system or account I am authorized to test.
- [ ] Sensitive platform findings were reported privately before operational details were published.
